name: WebGL Gaussian Splatting
definition: A WebGL 1.0 renderer that treats Gaussian splats as point clouds, projecting them to screen space and rendering bounding quadrilaterals shaded by a fragment shader.
summary: WebGL Gaussian Splatting is a real-time web rendering technique that performs depth sorting in a JavaScript Web Worker and projects 3D Gaussians into screen-space quads, distinguishing itself by providing a complete pipeline rather than just shading logic.
